name: Bosch Ltd
title: Bosch Ltd - 500530 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bosch FY26 revenue up 10.8% to INR200.3bn and Q4 EBITDA up 20.8%, but FY27 volume guided flattish with management cautious on West Asia and no numeric guidance given.

triggers.label: Air-systems JV with Brakes India and Wheels India
triggers.quote: we are pleased to announce a joint venture with Brakes India Private Limited and Wheels India Limited

triggers.label: PV dealer inventory 52 → 28 days
triggers.quote: inventory levels normalized to a healthy average of approximately 28 days compared to an average of approximately 52 days in the previous year

triggers.label: FY27 volume outlook flattish
triggers.quote: So, we currently maintained a flattish outlook.

triggers.label: Power Solutions FY26 growth 17.6%
triggers.quote: the Power Solutions business, which grew by 17.6%, driven by higher demand in the overall automotive segment

guidance.metric: FY27 industry and own volume outlook
guidance.value: flattish; PC, CV, tractor 'steady' or 'stable' growth, no numbers
guidance.quote: So, we currently maintained a flattish outlook.

red_flags.label: Chassis acquisition details withheld pending regulatory approval
red_flags.quote: till we formalize that we would resist from giving you this kind of details

red_flags.label: Independent aftermarket stagnated
red_flags.quote: The independent aftermarket stagnated as it continued to face significant supply chain pressures.

evasions.topic: Robert Bosch Chassis Systems FY26 financials
evasions.quote: we can't before the closing and not disclose figures here for the company, Robert Bosch Chassis Systems

evasions.topic: JV funding requirement and content per vehicle size
evasions.quote: I do not want to speculate and give you a number now.
So, it's very hard to give you a percentage.
